summary_text: Fifteen years of administrative experience in a distribution business. I want to move toward data or operations work.

work_entries.title: Administrative Coordinator
work_entries.description: I prepare the monthly MIS report for the operations head using Excel pivot tables and cross-check figures against the dispatch register before sending. I schedule meetings and site visits for a team of 12 and send follow-up emails to vendors for pending deliveries. I keep the filing system and digital records for purchase and dispatch documents. I write minutes of meeting after weekly reviews and track action items. I track monthly petty cash and expense statements for the department. I have entered purchase entries in the company ERP system.
